legal.legal_1_body: NutriSnap is provided "as is". The developer, Dorian Naaji, disclaims all liability regarding the accuracy of nutritional calculations or health decisions made based on the generated analyses. This information does not constitute medical advice.
legal.legal_2_body: No data is collected on any third-party server by the developer. All your information (profile, history) is stored exclusively on your device (IndexedDB). Dorian Naaji has no access to your data.
legal.legal_3_body: When you analyse a meal, the image and your nutritional context are sent to the Google Gemini API to generate the analysis. NutriSnap does not retain this data. These transfers are governed by Google's privacy policy.
legal.legal_4_body: NutriSnap uses no tracking cookies. IndexedDB storage is first-party local storage required for the app to function. Your data stays on your device and can be deleted at any time from your profile.
legal.os_1_body: NutriSnap's source code is entirely public and Open Source. This transparency allows every user to verify exactly how the application works.
legal.os_2_body: The entire codebase of this application was generated by Claude (Anthropic). This project demonstrates the ability of LLMs to design complex, secure, privacy-respecting applications.
legal.os_3_body: You can view, fork, or contribute to the project on GitHub. The architecture uses Angular, Material Design, and Dexie.js for a 100% local experience.
